variants.transcript: The gravitas plague spreads. Officials are warning residents to stay indoors after new cases of the gravitas plague were confirmed across the city. Doctors say the illness attacks the brain's fear response. Early victims may seem confused, sleepless, or strangely calm. Later symptoms include cloudy eyes, broken speech, fixation on movement, and sudden violence. One hospital worker said, "They look awake, but unreachable." The infected are not dead. They're living hosts with severe brain damage. Residents are advised to lock doors, avoid contact with aggressive animals, and report any bite or fluid exposure immediately. If someone you know appears infected, do not open the door. If the eyes cloud, isolate. If speech fails, do not negotiate.

performance.tone: broadcast reading, lazy, dry, unimpressed, protective underneath
